source.name: Volt Absorb
source.originalDescription: Gains 8% of damage received as bonus Attack for 4s (maximum 200 bonus Attack from 2,500 damage received). Gain an electric charge when receiving damage, converting a portion of that damage into additional Attack.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Volt Absorb は 受けるダメージを軽減する。

source.name: Attack
source.originalDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage and paralyzing opposing Pokémon hit, and restoring 10% missing HP per target hit. The movement speed of paralyzed targets is decreased by 15% for 2.5s and their auto attack speed is decreased by 25% for 1s. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage and paralyzing the enemy while restoring some of Zeraora's HP.

source.name: Slash
source.originalDescription: Pounces toward the designated opposing Pokémon's location and attacks with 3 sharp claw swipes, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and throwing those hit by the last swipe for 0.5s. Pounce at an enemy and attack with sharp claws. This move's final attack throws enemies.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Slash は 相手を打ち上げる。

source.name: Plasma Gale
source.originalDescription: Becomes unstoppable for 0.5s and launches a bolt of lightning toward the designated target; damaging opposing Pokémon in its path toward the target and throwing them for 0.5s. Once the bolt reaches the target; damages opposing Pokémon in an area of effect and throws them once again. Creates a circular zone of plasma centered on the target's location for 5s when it hits; paralyzing opposing Pokémon inside it for 3s. While in the zone, also increases the user's auto attack range, and auto attack damage by 20%. Unleash a blast of lightning, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and throw them. This also creates a zone of plasma that increases the user's basic attack range and damage dealt while inside this zone. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 20% Attack Speed, 15% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Plasma Gale は まひを付与する、相手を打ち上げる、妨害無効になる、与ダメージを変化させる、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する。
